We have carried out whole-genome bisulfite sequencing… 13955536 the-dynamics-of-genome-wide-dna-methylation-reprogramming-in-mouse-primordial-germ-cells dynamics genome wide dna methylation reprogramming mouse primordial Genome-wide DNA methylation reprogramming occurs in mouse primordial germ cells (PGCs) and preimplantation embr The Dynamics of Genome-wide DNA Methylation Reprogramming in Mouse Primordial Germ Cells Genome-wide DNA methylation reprogramming occurs in mouse primordial germ cells (PGCs) and preimplantation embryos, but the precise dynamics and biological outcomes are largely unknown. We have carried out whole-genome bisulfite sequencing (BS-Seq) and RNA-Seq across key stages from E6.5 epiblast to E16.5 PGCs. Global loss of methylation takes place during PGC expansion and migration with evidence for passive demethylation, but sequences that carry long-term epigenetic memory (imprints, CpG islands on the X chromosome, germline-specific genes) only become demethylated upon entry of PGCs into the gonads.
